thread:
Nadia: Short recap from three post-kickoff calls — grouping signals here so PMs can triage. Top recurring asks: route-level cost telemetry, a printable kickoff checklist for admins, quicker embedding re-ingest options, and one SSO attribute mapping that's at-risk for renewal. Dropping compact rows below.
Omar: thanks Nadia. can you put the renewal-risk row first?
Nadia: sure. TL;DR rows (minimal):
- P0 | renewal_risk=yes | client: horizon-co | issue: SSO attr mismatch (idp uses 'uid', we expect 'email') | note: renewal in 14 days
- P1 | renewal_risk=no | client: papertrail | issue: route-cost telemetry | note: wants per-route daily CSV + API endpoint
- P1 | renewal_risk=no | client: brightworks | issue: kickoff-checklist | note: printed steps + sample tasks for new admins
- P2 | renewal_risk=no | client: zenloop | issue: embed-reingest | note: wants manual reingest button + webhook when reindexed
Felix: I'll pick up the route-cost telemetry spike. propose fields: route_id, route_label, tokens_sent, tokens_generated, model_name, cost_estimate_usd, interval_start. I'll sketch a sample SQL and a CSV example.
Greta: for the SSO row — Nadia please attach IdP logs and the user mapping table. If renewal is within 30 days, we escalate to eng-oncall.
Nadia: attached minimal CSV excerpt and IdP snippet in the shared drive. CSV snippet:```client_id,issue,prio,notes
horizon-21,SSO mapping,P0,IdP sends 'uid' not 'email' -> login 401
paper-9,route-cost,P1,request: daily CSV and UI drilldown
```
Felix: sample SQL to count affected routes this quarter (will post actual query to #analytics):```SELECT route_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens_total, COUNT(*) as calls FROM logs WHERE tenant_id = ? AND ts >= now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY route_id;```
Greta: I'll create CS ticket CS-9981 for Horizon and mark blocking_renewal. Add "time_to_respond" = 48h in the ticket.
sarah-bot: Ticket CS-9981 created and linked to thread. Assigned to @eng-oncall.
Omar: For the kickoff-checklist, can we make a 1-page printable PDF + a JSON schema for programmatic generation? If so, DevEx can auto-fill customer name and initial routes.
Felix: yes. I'll model the checklist as a small YAML/JSON schema with sections: pre-kickoff, first-login, sample-prompts, idp-mapping. ETA prototype tomorrow.
Nadia: Also suggest adding intake columns in the sheet: "blocking_renewal", "impact_estimate_usd/month", "num_accounts_reported", "first_reported_date". That should improve PM prioritization.
Omar: agreed. I'll update the intake sheet and surface top-3 in Friday's PM sync.
Nadia: thanks team — consolidating threads into product-intake and linking CS-9981 + Felix's telemetry spike. Will ping once intake row is updated. :sparkles:
